_comment: Hand-maintained. Different courses that count for one another when a student's majors each require one of them: the plan keeps the first major's course and it serves both (lib/programMerge.js). Not an equivalence for prerequisites (that is the Prototype's catalog/equivalents.json). Keep one entry per pair, with who said so and when.

groups.why: BIOL 3920 Biological Communication Skills and CHEM 4920 Chemistry Seminar count for the same credit in a Biology and Chemistry double major. Reported by the project owner from a Biology/Chemistry double-major plan, 2026-10-14; to be confirmed with the departments.
